text: When a writable dismiss loses its acknowledgement during modifyItem, the service stores parent-hashId|ackTime locally. Past writable alarms use the later local or parent acknowledgement, which keeps the dismissed occurrence suppressed without blanket suppression of later recurrences. Future alarms use a separate scheduling branch. Bare-id entries retain whole-item suppression, and the unchanged snooze fallback can still create that format. In-memory tests check selected occurrence/timer states; no CalDAV server or profile restart ran.
title: Alarm suppression compares local and parent acknowledgement times for past alarms
